verses.text: This is what the LORD says: “Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce with which I sent her away? Or to which of My creditors did I sell you? Look, you were sold for your iniquities, and for your transgressions your mother was sent away.

xrefs.text: How could one man pursue a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the LORD had given them up?
She saw that because faithless Israel had committed adultery, I gave her a certificate of divorce and sent her away. Yet that unfaithful sister Judah had no fear and prostituted herself as well.
Since the man was unable to pay, the master ordered that he be sold to pay his debt, along with his wife and children and everything he owned.

We and our children are just like our countrymen and their children, yet we are subjecting our sons and daughters to slavery. Some of our daughters are already enslaved, but we are powerless to redeem them because our fields and vineyards belong to others.”

Now the wife of one of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, “Your servant, my husband, is dead, and you know that your servant feared the LORD. And now his creditor is coming to take my two children as his slaves!”

verses.text: Why was no one there when I arrived? Why did no one answer when I called? Is My hand too short to redeem you? Or do I lack the strength to deliver you? Behold, My rebuke dries up the sea; I turn the rivers into a desert; the fish rot for lack of water and die of thirst.

xrefs.text: Surely the arm of the LORD is not too short to save, nor His ear too dull to hear.

So I will choose their punishment and I will bring terror upon them, because I called and no one answered, I spoke and no one listened. But they did evil in My sight and chose that in which I did not delight.”
The LORD answered Moses, “Is the LORD’s arm too short? Now you will see whether or not My word will come to pass.”

He made darkness His hiding place, and storm clouds a canopy around Him.
Then the LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward heaven, so that darkness may spread over the land of Egypt— a palpable darkness.”
From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land.

verses.text: The Lord GOD has given Me the tongue of discipleship, to sustain the weary with a word. He awakens Me morning by morning; He awakens My ear to listen as a disciple.

xrefs.text: For I will give you speech and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
Then the LORD reached out His hand, touched my mouth, and said to me: “Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.
The Jews were amazed and asked, “How did this man attain such learning without having studied?
And the LORD said to him, “Who gave man his mouth? Or who makes the mute or the deaf, the sighted or the blind? Is it not I, the LORD?
A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

verses.text: The Lord GOD has opened My ears, and I have not been rebellious, nor have I turned back.

xrefs.text: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Get up! Let us go on from here.
Although He was a Son, He learned obedience from what He suffered.
And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death— even death on a cross.
Then the eyes of the blind will be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped.
He who sent Me is with Me. He has not left Me alone, because I always do what pleases Him.

verses.text: I offered My back to those who struck Me, and My cheeks to those who tore out My beard. I did not hide My face from scorn and spittle.

xrefs.text: Then they spit in His face and struck Him. Others slapped Him
Then some of them began to spit on Him. They blindfolded Him, struck Him with their fists, and said to Him, “Prophesy! And the officers received Him with slaps in His face.
They kept striking His head with a staff and spitting on Him. And they knelt down and bowed before Him.
The men who were holding Jesus began to mock Him and beat Him.
Then they spit on Him and took the staff and struck Him on the head repeatedly.

verses.text: Because the Lord GOD helps Me, I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set My face like flint, and I know that I will not be put to shame.

xrefs.text: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
Behold, I will make your face as hard as their faces, and your forehead as hard as their foreheads.
I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!
[“]Here is My Servant, whom I uphold, My Chosen One, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will bring justice to the nations.
I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, first to the Jew, then to the Greek.

verses.text: The One who vindicates Me is near. Who will dare to contend with Me? Let us confront each other! Who has a case against Me? Let him approach Me!

xrefs.text: He who did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all, how will He not also, along with Him, freely give us all things?
“Be silent before Me, O islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come forward and testify; let us together draw near for judgment.

And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying: “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down— he who accuses them day and night before our God.
“Present your case,” says the LORD. “Submit your arguments,” says the King of Jacob.
Remind Me, let us argue the matter together. State your case, so that you may be vindicated.

verses.text: Surely the Lord GOD helps Me. Who is there to condemn Me? See, they will all wear out like a garment; the moths will devour them.

xrefs.text: So man wastes away like something rotten, like a moth-eaten garment.
They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment.
They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will be passed on.
Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
You discipline and correct a man for his iniquity, consuming like a moth what he holds dear; surely each man is but a vapor. Selah

verses.text: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of His Servant? Who among you walks in darkness and has no light? Let him trust in the name of the LORD; let him lean on his God.

xrefs.text: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.
But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

verses.text: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who array yourselves with firebrands, walk in the light of your fire and of the firebrands you have lit! This is what you will receive from My hand: You will lie down in a place of torment.

xrefs.text: This is what the LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes mere flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD.
For although they knew God, they neither glorified Him as God nor gave thanks to Him, but they became futile in their thinking and darkened in their foolish hearts.
Because they were ignorant of God’s righteousness and sought to establish their own, they did not submit to God’s righteousness.
That is why I told you that you would die in your sins. For unless you believe that I am He, you will die in your sins.
